title: associate accuracy report
description: The harness-written accuracy counts for one run: per kind, per source kind, reviewer flags, whether the Python re-check ran, and child runs listed with their own counts. A passed fact means its quote was found in the saved result it cites, nothing more.

unchecked_text.description: Sentences the model wrote outside the checked items: in the hand-back's summary and in its final message. Counted by the extension; never part of the statements counts.

support_scored.description: How many facts the decider gave a support answer (how much of the value the quote, on its own, shows). Written by the extension; absent when the score is switched off. A count of facts answered, whatever the answer: it is no part of the facts counts and says nothing about whether a value is true.

strict.description: Written by the extension when strict facts ran. Facts counted by how they were checked, never by whether a value is correct: direct_passed (the harness found the evidence), llm_judged and derived (passed on the decider's answer), kept_with_mark (kept with the contract's mark), returned, not_judged, dropped (facts only, in total and per reason), by_stated_kind (facts per kind as the model stated it, with how many of those passed the direct check alone), worded (facts whose value was in the model's own words) and judged (facts the decider answered for).

worded.description: Facts whose value was in the model's own wording (not word for word in its evidence), whatever happened to them next. Absent in exports written before plan deviation d3.

judged.description: Facts the decider gave an answer for (the support or the derived question), whatever the answer. Absent in exports written before plan deviation d3.

support_answers.description: How many facts got each support answer: one count per option of the contract's support_score.options, in that order, zeros included. Written by the extension; absent when the score is switched off. No part of the facts counts, and no answer means the value is true.

children.description: Each child or delegated run with its own counts (a report of this same shape). Listed, never summed into this run's counts.
